use_cases.name: Authenticate User
use_cases.description: User logs in via Azure AD SSO to access the system

use_cases.name: Submit Expense Claim
use_cases.description: Employee submits expense with amount, category, date, receipt photo, and description

use_cases.name: View Expense History
use_cases.description: Employee views their submitted expenses from the last 6 months

use_cases.name: Review Approval Queue
use_cases.description: Manager views pending expense claims awaiting approval or rejection

use_cases.name: Approve Expense Claim
use_cases.description: Manager approves an expense claim and sends notification to employee

use_cases.name: Reject Expense Claim
use_cases.description: Manager rejects an expense claim with comment and sends notification to employee

use_cases.name: Export Monthly Report
use_cases.description: Finance staff exports all approved expenses for the month as CSV for reimbursement processing
